**Known caveats:**
1. **fp16_tflops for Pascal** (GTX 10xx, P40, MX1xx-3xx) is the literal 1/64-rate FP16. llama.cpp runs these cards in FP32, so for speed estimates the app should use about 64x this value (e.g. GTX 1080 Ti about 11.3, P40 about 11.8). Otherwise it will wrongly rate them as unusable.
2. **Apple fp16_tflops is listed at the FP32 rate.** The A19/M5-generation GPU (Apple10) reportedly doubles FP16 throughput and adds per-core neural accelerators, so M5, M5 Pro, M5 Max, M5 Ultra, M6, A19 and A20 FP16 may be about 2x the table value. For LLM decode, bandwidth dominates anyway.
3. **Adreno X2-90 cannot be told apart by string** between X2E-88 (152 GB/s) and X2 Elite Extreme (228 GB/s). The table uses the conservative 152.
4. **Mali strings:** Tensor G2-G4 entries match only if the driver string includes a core count (MC7/MP7). Otherwise the generic Mali-G7xx entries catch them, which is fine.
5. **Safari and iOS return "apple gpu"** and cannot tell iPhone, iPad and Mac apart. Consider a software-renderer check (strings with "swiftshader", "llvmpipe" or "microsoft basic render") outside this table and treat those as no GPU.
6. **Excluded as unreleased as of 2026-09-29:** NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X (October 2026), RTX 50 SUPER (on hold) and Intel Arc B770 (on hold). Add them when they ship.
